correctness.rationale: PASS: On the dense nonsingular 2x2 minor chart, unique recurrence a_{j+2}=Sa_{j+1}-Pa_j yields field C(A,B,S,P). Fixing A=a0,B=a1,C=a3 gives P=(BS^2-C)/(AS+B), so function field is C(A,B,C)(S). Only possible finite pole is -B/A. Delta=A^2*C-B^3 nonzero generically forces the degree n-4 at infinity. For t=n-1, highest P power has coefficient (-1)^m A when t=2m and (-1)^m(B+mAS) when t=2m+1; evaluated at S=-B/A nonzero for m>=2, giving floor(t/2) pole. Degree is sum of pole orders, generic separability in characteristic 0. Independent symbolic recurrence with rational A,B,C verified n=5..11. Proof covers all n, not extrapolated.
